document_summary: San Francisco Rent Board table of current rates (March 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027) covering the allowable annual rent increase, security deposit interest, and eviction relocation payments.

rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance allowable annual rent increase
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the allowable annual rent increase for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.coverage_conditions: Units covered by the San Francisco Rent Ordinance; coverage thresholds are not stated in this document.
rules.interaction: Local rent control operating alongside state law (Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.12 and the Costa-Hawkins Act); this document does not discuss that relationship.
rules.extraction_notes: Effective date taken from the stated effective period starting March 1, 2026. The prior periods were 1.4% (3/1/25–2/28/26) and 1.7% (3/1/24–2/28/25). The code citation is not given in this document and is supplied from knowledge of the Rent Ordinance.

rules.title: SF security deposit interest rate
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on tenant security deposits at the Rent Board rate, which is 4.2% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential tenancies subject to San Francisco's security deposit interest rules; thresholds are not stated in this document.
rules.extraction_notes: Prior rates were 5.0% (3/1/25–2/28/26) and 5.2% (3/1/24–2/28/25). The citation is not given in this document and is supplied from knowledge of the SF Administrative Code.

rules.title: SF relocation payments for no-fault evictions
rules.requirement: For no-fault evictions (owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation), landlords must pay relocation amounts set by the Rent Board. Notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27 carry a per-tenant amount, a per-unit maximum, and an additional amount for elderly, disabled or minor-child households.
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; max $24,733.00 per unit; plus $5,497.00 per elderly (60+)/disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren)
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies by the date the notice of termination of tenancy was served: 3/01/26 – 2/28/27.
rules.interaction: Temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance § 37.9C.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.extraction_notes: Ellis Act evictions (§ 37.9A), notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27: $11,110.05 per tenant, max $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 per elderly (62+) or disabled tenant. Temporary displacement under 20 days: $446.00/day per tenant household plus actual moving expenses. Prior period (3/01/25–2/28/26) per-tenant amount was $8,062.00. This document is a rate table and does not state the underlying just-cause grounds. The effective date is the start of the stated rate period.
